subject: per-phy-u-fund
title: PER.PHY.U.FUND.------CRTF.D.
description: Diagram opening MP(II)-4 — the section on transfer-shifts as the natural-and-forced consideration coupling humanity's acquisition of world-creativity to its spread, solidification, and destruction. The prose below identifies the structural target: 'For the historical acquisition of world culture bounty was not separate from the realness of war and devastation — and the later economic considerations related to this phenomenon were imposed rather than copied.' The crossing diagrams how the perceived physical universe fundamental structurally meets cross-transfer-definitions at the world-cultural-acquisition scale: PER-PHY-U-FUND (perceived physical universe fundamental) crossed with CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions — the partner-axis converter that the acquiring culture supplies). PER-PHY-U-FUND sits on the left with the subject-arrow, and the main line runs from it to CRTF-D at top-right; APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) rises from the main line at top-center, with AFL-DYM (affinity dynamics) branching from it at upper-left. TR-INFO (trans-information) branches from the main line out to the right margin; SCI-DYM (scientific dynamics) and FUND-DYM (fundamental dynamics) both branch from the TR-INFO line, MT-INFO (multi-information) branches from the FUND-DYM line at lower-right, and VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) branches from the MT-INFO line at the bottom.
